roster: four controlled development keys; freeze all non-author keys, including evidenced disqualified keys in the denominator
aggregation: ceil(2*n/3) real matching native-checked reveals; disqualified keys never count; frozen denominator never decreases
appeals: bounded hash-only audit records; no adoption veto, suspension, synthetic votes, score changes or past-effect reversal
conflicts: strictly verified signed equivocation excludes that key from current and future counts; recount in the same native adoption transaction
generation_binding: network, parameters, family, model/evaluation plan, dataset root, actual parent release and round number
